_help.how_to_run: .\.venv\Scripts\python tts.py examples\template_en.json --backend en=chatterbox   (chatterbox follows emotions; the default Qwen backend takes delivery from the clip)
_help.voices: Each speaker's ref_wav is the default voice. A line with emotion 'X' uses voices/<name>_X.wav if it exists, else its group's clip, else the default.
_help.sad_group (uses _sad.wav): sad lonely regretful disappointed hurt emotional pleading heartbroken desperate crying sobbing
_help.soft_group (uses _soft.wav): bored calm cold soft tired whisper shy tender serious neutral romantic
_help.happy_group (uses _happy.wav): relieved hopeful grateful confident proud happy cheerful playful excited laughing
_help.angry_group (uses _angry.wav): sarcastic annoyed jealous disgusted frustrated angry furious shouting
_help.surprised_group (uses _surprised.wav): curious confused nervous anxious scared surprised shocked terrified panicked
_help.line_options: paragraph: true = longer pause | pause_before_ms: exact pause | exaggeration: 0-2 (chatterbox) | instruct: extra English direction | tags like [laugh] [sigh] [gasp] inside text (chatterbox)
_help.invented_voice: English speakers can use "design": "description of the voice" instead of ref_wav

lines.speaker: Narr
lines.text: It had been three years since they last spoke.

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: Hi, Arif. I wasn't sure you'd want to see me.

lines.speaker: Arif
lines.text: Oh, of course. Three years of silence, and now you just show up.

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: Please, just let me explain. I never meant to hurt you.

lines.speaker: Arif
lines.text: [sigh] You don't know how many nights I waited for your call.

lines.speaker: Arif
lines.instruct: slowly, with a long breath before speaking

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: [laugh] You still remember how I like my tea?

lines.speaker: Narr
lines.text: And for the first time in years, the house felt warm again.
